_comment: Shared drift guard between the C# kernel and the TypeScript standalone modeller.
Both sides consume the same Operation IR but have separate executors: the kernel
drives real SOLIDWORKS B-rep, the modeller evaluates 2.5D geometry locally. They can
silently diverge, and divergence shows up as an offline rehearsal that does not match
what SOLIDWORKS actually produces — which is worse than having no rehearsal at all.
This file lists the operations the TypeScript engine claims to implement. The C# side
asserts every entry exists in OpCatalog; the TypeScript side asserts it handles every
entry. Adding an op to one engine without the other fails a build.
_knownGap: Operations the kernel implements but the standalone modeller deliberately does not.
These need a real geometric kernel; the modeller must not pretend to support them.
